# Mohammed Alhabbarah (محمد الحبارة)

> Head of Learning & Capability Development at CAMCO – Capital Metro Company (operator of Riyadh Metro Lines 1 and 2), Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Competency development expert and technical readiness leader: technical training, competency management systems (CMS), knowledge transfer, talent pipelines and workforce readiness in safety-critical industries (railways, oil & gas, construction). Arabic and English.

Arabic name: محمد الحبارة. Motto: “From the field… to impact” (من الميدان… إلى الأثر).
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammed-alhabbarah/
Website: https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/mohammed-alhabbarah/ (Arabic) · https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/mohammed-alhabbarah/en/ (English)

## Key facts

- Current role: Head of Learning & Capability Development, CAMCO (May 2026 – present), Riyadh Metro Project.
- Previous at CAMCO: Technical Capability Readiness Manager (May 2024 – May 2026); Competence Management System Expert (May 2023 – May 2024).
- Earlier: Training and Recruitment Specialist, Education For Employment Saudi (2021–2023); L&D Supervisor and L&D Specialist, Nasser S. Al-Hajri Corporation (2018–2021); Training Lead, OGM Technical Institute, Bahrain (2020–2021); Administrative Clerk, Abdullah Ali Al Amer & Brothers Trading Co (2016–2018).
- Delivered technical training to 3,220+ employees through 8,000+ learning interventions for Riyadh Metro operational readiness.
- Established CAMCO's Training Management System and Competency Management System, formally validated by the Transport General Authority (TGA).
- Honoured among the Riyadh Metro Heroes (Royal Commission for Riyadh City and Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development).
- Bronze award, Best Learning & Development Program, Saudi CX Awards 2025 (representing CAMCO).
- Part of the NSH team that won Saudi Aramco's IKTVA Award (2018) for Best in Training and Development of Saudi Manpower.
- Co-led the establishment of OGM Technical Institute in Bahrain; led competency reassessment and recertification for 600+ employees in safety-critical operations.
- Reduced training cycle time by 25% and raised post-training feedback by 40% (LMS automation, AI-enabled learning, enhanced TNA).
- Certifications: CPTD (ATD, 2024), PMP (PMI, 2021), SPTD (Human Capital Institute, 2023), TVTC Certified Trainer (2021), CLDM (Middle Earth HR, 2021), Competency Assessor & Verifier Training (2023), Internal Auditor Training (TÜV SÜD, 2024).
- Education: MBA in progress at Ahlia University, Bahrain (from 2026); CIPD Level 5 Associate Diploma in People Management (2021–2022); BA English Language & Literature, King Faisal University (2013–2017).
- Languages: Arabic (native), English (full professional).
